data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Decentralization is an illusion of resilience; it merely transforms 'Software Correlation' into 'Infrastructure Correlation' without increasing the actual failure threshold.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The decentralized network is physically distributed across truly independent infrastructure providers and protocols.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The primary failure modes are application-level bugs rather than infrastructure-level outages.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"While independent operators may use different software, they almost invariably rely on a small set of shared global primitives (TCP/IP, BGP, Root DNS, AWS/GCP/Azure).
